rows.label: Detonite Ampule
rows.note: Jat Kusar research, Ghost-tier; scales x3/x10/x30/x100 by clan tier

conditions: The chain is strictly sequential: Detonite Injector, then Jat Kittag, then Jat Kusar, each a 3-day timer at Ghost-clan tier.
Joining an established clan with the chain finished skips this whole step; it still sells the blueprint for 15,000 credits.

disclosures.title: research is the real gate
disclosures.body: Jat Kusar itself has no RNG. If the console says complete, this becomes a Detonite Ampule farm and a one-day Foundry build; if not, the research timers dominate.

conditions: Each player buys their own blueprint after clan research completes.

rows.label: Detonite Ampule
rows.alt: 3 free Injectors per Grineer-side Invasion reward

conditions: Nekros Desecrate, a Smeeta Kavat and resource boosters all apply to Ampules; a 10-20 minute Grineer Survival commonly nets 100+.
bonuses: Grineer-side Invasion rewards give 3 finished Detonite Injectors each, skipping the Ampules, Control Modules and the 12-hour builds.
